sizeGuide.title: Find your fit.
sizeGuide.instructions: Lay a favourite tee flat. Measure across the chest and double it, then compare garment length from shoulder to hem.

sections.title: How do I choose a size?
sections.text: Check the size guide and each product’s fit notes. Contact us if you need help choosing.

sections.title: Can I pay on delivery?
sections.text: Yes, Cash on Delivery is available for eligible delivery areas. Availability is checked at checkout.

sections.title: Where is my order?
sections.text: Use the Track Order page with your order number and email. Signed-in customers can also check their account.

sections.title: How do I care for my clothing?
sections.text: Follow the garment label. Each product page includes fabric and care notes.

sections.title: Delivery
sections.text: Draft policy — owner approval required before launch. The demo checkout uses a 4–7 business-day estimate. Confirm actual dispatch times, courier coverage and charges before accepting orders.

sections.title: Returns & exchanges
sections.text: Draft policy — contact support with your order number and reason for return. The owner must set the eligibility period, condition requirements, return shipping responsibility and refund timing before launch.

sections.title: Payment issues
sections.text: Contact support if payment was deducted but your order remains pending. Do not place repeated orders while an existing payment is being checked.

sections.title: Information used
sections.text: Draft for owner review. Farmeri processes account details, delivery information, order history and messages you submit to provide store services.

sections.title: Service providers
sections.text: Configured payment, image hosting and email providers process information necessary to complete the requested service. Card details are entered in the payment provider’s checkout.

sections.title: Your choices
sections.text: Contact the store to request access, correction or deletion of your information. Before launch, specify the responsible business, contact address, retention periods and applicable privacy obligations.

sections.title: Using Farmeri
sections.text: Draft terms for owner review before launch. Product listings, availability and pricing are subject to confirmation at checkout.

sections.title: Orders & payment
sections.text: An order may be cancelled if stock or payment cannot be confirmed. Online payment and fulfillment status can be checked in your account.

sections.title: Policies
sections.text: Shipping, returns and privacy terms apply alongside these terms. The owner must add business identity, jurisdiction and approved customer policies before launch.
